content: Nin mama mimi bekanaŋ pemann tapme Kilaisiyelen mama pembenaŋ ke mâbanup

Kilaisiyaŋ am sekmak maŋgeen kan keyet ningat nâmti sek sindem tiye. Kegogapmti in sek sindem tiwepgat weyaŋ mambep. An ŋen nâmkiŋpepeŋaŋgat sek sindem matin keyaŋ kaliŋaŋ bemti matazin ma bamgat tetimae ŋen ekmagen sokben beme yom mimiyet tikŋaŋ ku manâin.
Mme msalen mama mamain kataŋ amnaŋ yom mimiyet tikŋaŋ taindame mamip keboŋ ŋen egaŋ ku mbe yaŋgut egaŋ Kawawaŋaŋ mama mimi nâmtikŋaŋ mam ke etaŋ mbe.

Tipman baen nâmkiŋpepeŋinpiŋ mamti mama mimi kapigok mmamkwepbien: imbimak set kileŋ mama ma bekanaŋgat keŋinaŋ puŋpuŋ mimi ma tu katikŋaŋ nimti kiliŋ kaluŋ palen mama ma bo meu time kwaopme nimwiaŋti keyet keŋaset âmanda manda palen mama ma tu katikŋaŋ omba nimti keŋin kilom beme mama mimi bekanaŋ mimi ma nopiom notnaŋ sesewatindanup zemti keyet keŋaset mama mimi okbi okbiŋaŋmak mimi ma kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ ke mkwabien ke peme temelak.

Âpme in kan pi am nâmkiŋpepeŋinpiŋ ekŋenmak tusumti ku mamaip keyepmti ekŋenaŋ nâme in mama mimi bekanaŋ ke ekŋenmak tusum mbiek zemti ekme in ekŋenmak tusum ku mamaip kegogapm ingat ŋenzinziŋ omba mti zet bekanaŋ mandiindoip.
Yaŋgut ekŋenaŋ maneti Kawawaŋ am gakikiŋaŋ ma am alik mamaip yaŋaŋ msokbembeyet damuŋ matazin egat zikatnan an kwep kwewaŋ yaŋaŋin zewep.

Kogogapmti am Kawawaŋgalen buŋam zapat zenze an ekŋenaŋ am gakiwien ekŋen Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋ diindondoŋaŋ. Ekŋenaŋ msalen kapi mamti sek sindem tiwien mti nembetnaŋ zemdelaŋ zenze kanen keyet tosaŋin tiwep ma emetakŋinaŋ Kawawaŋmak meti mama kanzizit mambe keyet temakwep zewien.
Kan bududuk beingat nolinemak gogot palen mambep
Kan bududuk beme kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ sokbembeyet zenzeŋaŋ ke tasokbeingapmti dundundu mulup mene mene mimiyet keŋinaŋ weyaŋ nâmâtâti esemteŋ talip.
Gogot palen mama ke mama mimi dolakŋaŋ notnaŋ sebempein keyepm nodaŋgalen yomaŋ sambe kwatampeme tapmâbe mti ekŋengalen yuŋguŋguŋin keyet kogogak kandaindowe.
In noline mkaen indamandame kopme timbuluŋ indasâti zet kutuk palen ku mbep.
In Emetak Teŋaŋ taolet sepem ikŋak ikŋak indaye keyepmti taolet ke tim tati am sambe indamukulem mimi ke peme tatapiŋ mti mimiek mme Kawawaŋ taoletoŋgapm keŋ taolet ikŋak ikŋak ketalasim maindain.

An ŋenaŋ Kawawaŋgalen zet zapat zesâti egaŋ Kawawaŋaŋ zetnanen egalen zet zenzeyet zemâtâtpepeŋaŋ mâti nâmdelaŋ zemti zewe. An ŋen mukulem mimiyet taolet sasaŋaŋ beme Kawawaŋaŋ winde same keyet kataŋ mbe. In kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ Zisas Kilaisiyet pembenaŋgat kegok mme Kawawaŋgat kwit zapatnaŋ mmobe. Kawawaŋaŋ Zisas Kilaisiyet kwizet buŋamaŋ mme mmoti Amobotnaŋ tatagat winde same egalen winde keyaŋ kwesiŋ kwesiŋ tapmebep. Ke penaŋ.
Zisas nâmkiŋpem maipgapm sindem tiwep
Notnne penaŋ, ingat windeŋin mtot indendeyet kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ kukŋaŋbeŋ sokbemâgeyaŋ tapmezin. Âpme in kwileki ŋen mamanamaŋ sokbemndain zemti sebet diŋdiŋ ku mbep.

In Kilais manâmkiŋpeipgapmti sek sindem egaŋ tiyenok in tiwep kataŋ oloŋen mamambep. Âpme maneti bam gilik zemkosâpmnen busatnaŋ temaŋmak sokbemkawaŋ beme amnaŋ eksâip kan keyet keŋ dolakŋaŋ nâmti segeyek mbep.

Kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ kogok mimindame nâmbewenn Kawawaŋgalen Emetak Teŋ windeŋaŋmak egaŋ inmak tati keŋin mam imbelaŋaŋ bemindein keyepm in Kilais egat kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ mti mame am notnaŋ ekŋenaŋ zemtalalat zet diindome in keyet nâme dolakŋaŋ bewe.
Inmagengatnaŋ ŋenaŋ am ŋen kume gakiwe mene ma kambu tiwe mene ma mobotnaŋ sakam ikŋak ikŋak mbe mene ma am notnaŋgalen kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋgat eyak mme keboŋgat sindem sawep beme sakambukŋaŋmak.
Keyaŋgut in Kilaisiyelen am mamaip keyepmti sek sindem indame in keyet nâme sakambukŋaŋmak ku bewe. Kogok mimindawep beme Kawawaŋ sesewatpewep eneyet in indikmâtâti Kilaisiyelen am mamaip manzeip.

Nâip, Kawawaŋaŋ am ŋeneyelen yaŋin msokbembeyelen kanaŋ ilak yaŋ bein. Ninmagen ŋeŋaŋ yaŋbemti mmeti met bam am Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋgat wisat mamip ekŋenmagen zemdelaŋ zenze mulup mti tosaŋin bekanaŋ penaŋ indawe.
Kawawaŋgalen Zet Itnaŋanen zet ŋen kapigok tazin,

content.text: “An teŋ mamainaŋ Kawawaŋgalen zemdelaŋ zenze kanen kiŋgagat palen tabep. Am yomtoŋ Kawawaŋgalen Zet Zapat Dolakŋaŋ Penaŋgat wisat mti keŋ katik mamaip ekŋen Kawawaŋaŋ ku aŋgalaŋindewe, yek penaŋ.” (Totatatgalen Set 11:31)

content: Keyepmti Kawawaŋaŋ sisipeŋpeŋ inmagen sokbemindandayet nâme makozin beme ke ŋep penaŋ. Egaŋ ikŋaŋ indam mge kogogapm egaŋ in ŋep indikdamuŋ mbeyet keŋin ma sekŋin egat betnanen ketalasim samti kwitnaŋ kwitnaŋ dolakŋaŋ egaŋ nâmtikŋaŋ min ke ewe tusumti mbep.
